rows.name:
As time passes, more soldiers start
thinking foolishly and lose sight of
what loyalty really means.

rows.label: tlk45370122_01_msg0002
rows.name:
But Newt-kun's fiery loyalty reminds
me of Superbia in its prime.

rows.label: tlk45370122_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Once Newt-kun's role is done and the
Core Crystal returns, I'd like our
army to secure it.
